quests.title: The the El Alamein fountain Float
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. The till at the El Alamein fountain opens Saturday with an empty float because somebody took it to the pub. It has been going on longer than I have admitted to anyone. Sixty before the first Kings Cross customer, and I'll never say who. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: clear sixty for the the El Alamein fountain float
hand it over at the counter

quests.title: Tap On at Macleay Street
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. My Opal says I owe nineteen dollars for a trip from Kings Cross I never took on Easter Saturday. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. Take the same one to Bondi Junction and tell me what it charged you. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: tap on at Kings Cross, tap off at Bondi Junction
come back and tell me the fare

quests.title: RBT on Macleay Street
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. There's a breath test set up on Macleay Street since midnight. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. My brother-in-law needs the ute at the far end of Kings Cross without a conversation. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: get past the breath test on Macleay Street
then meet the ute at the far end

quests.title: One Stop From Fitzroy Gardens
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. I need to know the train from Kings Cross stops at Bondi Junction and doesn't sail through like it did on Friday. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Ride it at after the footy and photograph the sign. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: take the train to Bondi Junction

quests.title: Two From Fitzroy Gardens
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. Two of whatever's going near Fitzroy Gardens, here, hot, before the footy at nine sharp. I have got no proof, which is exactly why I am asking. It's Kings Cross; I'm not asking for much. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: pick up two from near Fitzroy Gardens

quests.title: Probationary at the Bourbon
quests.blurb: My knees are gone, so. A young constable has been doing his first solo patrol round the Bourbon since the last Sunday of the month. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. He's decided Kings Cross is his, so give him a story for the sergeant. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: lose the probationary constable near the Bourbon

quests.title: Cover at the Bourbon
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. I've got nobody for the the Bourbon shift at after the footy and a room full of Kings Cross people who've paid. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. Fifty of trade and one difficult person at the door. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: cover the fifty for the shift
and handle whoever's at the door

quests.title: Counting Kellett Street
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. Council says the Kellett Street car park is never full and I say it's full by peak hour. It might be nothing. It has not felt like nothing. Count both Kings Cross car parks, photograph whichever one makes me right. Come and find me after, either way.

steps.label: count the cars at Kellett Street

quests.title: The Kellett Street Order
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. The Kellett Street order came to seventy more than I'd budgeted and the supplier wants it by school pick-up. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. Find seventy in Kings Cross and photograph the receipt. Be polite about it. It costs nothing.

steps.label: square the seventy for the Kellett Street order
then photograph the receipt on the counter

quests.title: The the Wayside Chapel Complaint
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. Two women in activewear have photographed my bins outside the Wayside Chapel since Wednesday. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. One has Kings Cross council on speed dial; sort it however you sort things. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: deal with the two of them near the Wayside Chapel
